title: Startup of the box enumerator
statement: Let $c,C\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $x$ be a bit string. After exactly $2(|x|+1)$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$, the unary box-enumeration machine is in the loop state at level $c$, with its input head on the blank cell immediately to the right of the input, every work tape containing $1^{|x|+1}$ in cells $0,\ldots,|x|$ and blanks elsewhere, every work head at position $0$, and empty output.
replaced: Let $c, C \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $x$ be a bit string. After exactly $2(|x|+1)$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$, $\mathcal{P}_{c,C}$ is in control state $\mathrm{loop}_c$, with its input head on the blank cell right of the input, every work tape holding $1^{|x|+1}$ in cells $0,\dots,|x|$ and blanks elsewhere, every work head at cell $0$, and empty output; here $\mathcal{P}_{c,C}$ is the unary box-enumeration machine with $c+1$ work tapes, which writes $1^{|x|+1}$ on every work tape and then runs $c+1$ nested unary loops, emitting $C$ ones per innermost iteration, and $\mathrm{loop}_i$, $\mathrm{rewind}_i$, $\mathrm{advance}_i$, $\mathrm{emit}_j$ are its control states.
